scope: Initial combat guide: slanted stage1 view and taller wall/ruin faces. No final art or gameplay-rule change. Prologue/outskirts/dungeon unchanged.

projection.input: screen direction inverse-mapped to world, same235world speed and analog strength; same physical key now has a different world direction.
projection.camera: Fixed azimuth, no release drift; displayed per-axis lag at most8percent. Published1.16 spawn size preserved.

static_integrity.scope: UTF-8, delimiters, whitespace, JSON/Python syntax, resource existence, project settings; NOT GDScript parser/typechecking or gameplay.

growth_data_contract.scope: JSON schema/content and source integration markers only; not GDScript runtime/behavior.

magic_data_contract.scope: JSON validation, negative data controls and source markers/arithmetic; NOT GDScript runtime, UI, input dispatch or mobile tests.

feedback_source_contract.scope: 7 affected code/test/checker files: UTF-8, delimiters, whitespace, Python syntax, reaction constants, integration markers, engine-test registration and new dependency paths only. NOT the full project check or GDScript parser/type/runtime, rendering, or mobile input tests.

mobile_hud_source_contract.scope: Changed UTF-8 files, delimiters, Python syntax and integration source checks only. NOT GDScript parsing/typechecking, actual Control geometry, touch dispatch, rendering or mobile execution.

run_navigation_source_contract.scope: UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax and navigation SOURCE contracts only; NOT GDScript parsing/types, native execution, actual UI/input, or mobile testing.

combat_cues_source_contract.scope: Changed-source UTF-8/delimiters/Python syntax, hook order, bounds, isolation, reviewed GAME-024 RunState/GAME-030 view baselines with exact GAME-033 observations and GAME-038/039/040 version-gated pattern adapters and frozen v1/v2/v17, preserved engine runner. NOT Godot parser/type/runtime, visual quality, input dispatch, or FPS.

godot_runtime.scope: headless import, actual foundation/growth/magic/feedback/mobile-HUD/run-navigation/combat-cues GDScript tests and main boot; visual/mobile approval separate

platform: Linux/X11 DISPLAY=:99, Mesa llvmpipe, Dummy audio; controlled real main scene, mouse/native touch, manual fixed-step QA. Not user PC or mobile hardware.
development_fixes: Removed unused Projection constant colliding with Godot builtin type.
Revised fixed-world-input assumptions in camera/actor/audio tests to the actual inverse-mapped screen input while preserving exact authority/sevenRNG comparisons.
Actual oblique camera lag is limited in screen coordinates; received-hit/pack/radar direction follows the same transform.

render_probe.gd.source:
extends SceneTree
const Snapshot=preload("res://scripts/progression/run_snapshot.gd")
const Supplies=preload("res://tests/test_supplies.gd")
const Textures=preload("res://tests/test_portrait_reactions.gd")
const FOLDER:="res://.local_validation/GAME055/render-live"
var ui
var errors:Array=[]
var records:Array=[]
var mouse_controls:=0
func expect(ok:bool,label:String):
 if not ok:errors.append(label)
func _initialize():call_deferred("run")
func touch(id:int,at:Vector2,pressed:bool,canceled:bool=false):
 var event:=InputEventScreenTouch.new()
 event.index=id
 event.position=at
 event.pressed=pressed
 event.canceled=canceled
 Input.parse_input_event(event)
func click(control:Control):
 mouse_controls+=1
 await process_frame
 await process_frame
 if ui._scroll.is_ancestor_of(control):ui._scroll.ensure_control_visible(control)
 await process_frame
 await process_frame
 var at:Vector2=control.get_global_rect().get_center()
 var motion:=InputEventMouseMotion.new()
 motion.position=at
 Input.parse_input_event(motion)
 var event:=InputEventMouseButton.new()
 event.button_index=MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
 event.position=at
 event.pressed=true
 Input.parse_input_event(event)
 await process_frame
 event=event.duplicate()
 event.pressed=false
 Input.parse_input_event(event)
 await process_frame
func resize(size:Vector2i,inset:float=0):
 root.content_scale_mode=Window.CONTENT_SCALE_MODE_DISABLED
 root.content_scale_size=size
 root.size=size
 DisplayServer.window_set_size(size)
 ui.root_ui.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
 ui.root_ui.size=Vector2(size)
 ui.safe_area_override=Rect2(Vector2(inset,6),Vector2(size)-Vector2(inset*2,18))
 ui._apply_layout()
 await process_frame
 await process_frame
 ui._apply_layout()
func capture(tag:String):
 ui._update_hud();ui.view.queue_redraw()
 var state:Dictionary=Snapshot.capture(ui.simulation);var clocks:Dictionary=ui.simulation.feedback.clocks.duplicate(true)
 await process_frame;await process_frame;await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
 expect(root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(FOLDER.path_join(tag+".png"))==OK,"capture "+tag)
 expect(Snapshot.capture(ui.simulation)==state and ui.simulation.feedback.clocks==clocks,"render read only "+tag)
 records.append({"tag":tag,"expression":ui.feedback_panel.expression_key,"feedback":ui.feedback_panel.state_key,"art_visible":ui.feedback_panel.portrait.visible,"exact_art":ui.feedback_panel.expression_has_art,"danger":ui.feedback_panel.danger_text.text,"phase":ui.simulation.phase,"hp":ui.simulation.hp,"viewport":str(root.size),"oblique":ui.view.uses_oblique(),"occluders":ui.view.high_renderer.stats.get("occluders",0),"camera":str(ui.view.camera_center())})
func step(count:int):
 for i in range(count):ui._physics_process(.05);await process_frame
func hp_item():
 var item:Dictionary=Supplies.drop(ui.simulation,"hp");item.p=ui.simulation.player;ui._physics_process(.01)
func run():
 DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(FOLDER)
 ui=load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate()
 ui.run_store.path=FOLDER.path_join("battle.save");ui.gold_progress.path=FOLDER.path_join("gold.cfg");ui.settings_path=FOLDER.path_join("settings.cfg")
 for path in [ui.run_store.path,ui.gold_progress.path,ui.settings_path]:DirAccess.remove_absolute(path)
 root.add_child(ui);ui.set_physics_process(false);await process_frame;await resize(Vector2i(1280,720))
 await click(ui.start_button);await click(ui.stage_launch_button)
 var s=ui.simulation
 s.spawn_clock=999;s.shot_clock=999;s._scatter_clock=999;s._swarm_clock=999
 expect(ui.view.uses_oblique(),"real stage1 departure uses fixed oblique presentation")
 await capture("gate")
 s.player=Vector2(1180,1290);ui.view.camera.reset(s.run_id)
 ui.view.oblique_enabled=false;await capture("before")
 ui.view.oblique_enabled=true;await capture("after")
 s.player=Vector2(1785,2730);ui.view.camera.reset(s.run_id)
 await capture("occluded")
 expect(ui.view.high_renderer.stats.occluders>0,"real terrain overlapping the hero fades")
 s.player=Vector2(1820,2910);ui.view.camera.reset(s.run_id)
 await capture("tower")
 s.player=Vector2(2500,1700);ui.view.camera.reset(s.run_id)
 var anchor:Vector2=ui.movement.get_global_transform_with_canvas()*ui.layout_data.move.get_center()
 touch(4,anchor,true);await process_frame
 var drag:=InputEventScreenDrag.new();drag.index=4;drag.position=anchor+Vector2(60,0);Input.parse_input_event(drag);await process_frame
 var start:Vector2=s.player;await step(20)
 var delta:Vector2=ui.view.project_direction(s.player-start)
 touch(4,anchor,false);await process_frame
 expect(delta.x>20 and absf(delta.y)<.1,"native joystick right moves along screen-right without changed world speed")
 var center:Vector2=ui.view.camera_center();await step(10)
 expect(ui.view.camera_center()==center,"camera stays fixed after release")
 ui.pause_game();var before:Dictionary=Snapshot.capture(s);var matrix:Transform2D=ui.view.ground_transform();await step(5)
 expect(before==Snapshot.capture(s) and matrix==ui.view.ground_transform(),"pause freezes camera and authority")
 expect(ui.battle_save_error==OK and DirAccess.copy_absolute(ui.run_store.path,FOLDER.path_join("tilted.save"))==OK,"original atomic writer accepts actual progressed stage for cold restart")
 await click(ui.resume_button);ui._physics_process(.01)
 s.add_pickup(s.player,s.growth.threshold());ui._physics_process(.01)
 await capture("choice")
 before=Snapshot.capture(s);matrix=ui.view.ground_transform();await step(5)
 expect(before==Snapshot.capture(s) and matrix==ui.view.ground_transform(),"choice freezes projection and same offer")
 while s.phase==s.Phase.CHOOSING:
  await click(ui.choice_buttons[0]);ui._physics_process(.01)
 # True projected offscreen markers and foreground attack warning in the actual renderer.
 s.enemies.clear();s._scatter_index=3
 var at:Vector2=ui.view.screen_to_world(Vector2(-20,ui.view.size.y*.5))
 s.add_enemy(at,"normal","fast",3)
 s.add_enemy(s.player+Vector2(600,80),"boss")
 ui._physics_process(0)
 expect(not ui.view.approach_cues().is_empty(),"rotated-edge pack cue survives AABB corner")
 await capture("warnings")
 var key:=InputEventKey.new();key.pressed=true;key.keycode=KEY_F8
 ui._unhandled_key_input(key);expect(not ui.view.high_angle,"actual F8 enters legacy renderer");await capture("f8")
 ui._unhandled_key_input(key);expect(ui.view.uses_oblique(),"actual F8 restores stage presentation")
 await resize(Vector2i(960,540),12);await capture("compact")
 await resize(Vector2i(1600,720),28);await capture("wide")
 var other:Array=[]
 for map in ["prologue_wall","outskirts_trial","gold_slime"]:
  s.start(5502,"viya",null,map,"weapons_v1",{},"gold_slime" if map=="gold_slime" else "campaign",5502 if map=="gold_slime" else -1)
  ui.view.camera.reset(s.run_id);ui.view.actors.reset(s.run_id)
  var pixels:Array=[]
  for mode in [false,true]:
   ui.view.oblique_enabled=mode;ui._update_hud();ui.view.queue_redraw();await process_frame;await process_frame;await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
   pixels.append(root.get_texture().get_image().get_data())
  expect(pixels[0]==pixels[1] and not ui.view.uses_oblique(),"other-map pixels unchanged:"+map)
  other.append({"map":map,"pixels_equal":pixels[0]==pixels[1]})
 var result:Dictionary={"status":"PASS" if errors.is_empty() else "FAIL","errors":errors,"screens":records,"other_maps":other,"mouse_controls":mouse_controls,"native_touch_steps":20,"schema":Snapshot.VERSION,"fingerprint":Snapshot.fingerprint()}
 var f=FileAccess.open(FOLDER.path_join("report.json"),FileAccess.WRITE);f.store_string(JSON.stringify(result,"  "));f.close();print(JSON.stringify(result))
 ui.combat_audio.stop_all();await create_timer(.06).timeout;ui.queue_free();await process_frame;await create_timer(.1).timeout;quit(0 if errors.is_empty() else 1)
